cluster_size_diagnostics: Not supplied: cluster sizes cannot be reconstructed.
null_tests: Not computed: saved bootstrap distribution is not a null distribution.
holm: Not computed: Holm requires valid raw p-values from defensible null tests.
interpretation: The bootstrap mean's displacement from the observed fairness effect is a diagnostic warning about bias/nonlinearity or estimand mismatch. It does not by itself invalidate the observed point estimate, nor does a percentile/basic interval or bootstrap sign fraction establish a null-hypothesis significance result. BCa requires delete-one-cluster jackknife estimates of the same fairness estimator.
next_required_for_final_significance: Reconstruct cluster-level sufficient contributions from the frozen event files.
Compute a delete-one-conversation jackknife of the exact fairness delta.
Specify a valid paired null procedure (e.g. conversation-level paired randomization/permutation, if exchangeability is justified).
Recompute raw p-values and apply Holm across the prespecified family.
